attempt_responses_score_check.name: attempt_responses_score_check
attempt_responses_score_check.value: "attempt_responses"."score" IS NULL OR ("attempt_responses"."score" >= 0 AND "attempt_responses"."max_score" IS NOT NULL AND "attempt_responses"."score" <= "attempt_responses"."max_score")

attempts_score_check.name: attempts_score_check
attempts_score_check.value: "attempts"."score" IS NULL OR ("attempts"."score" >= 0 AND "attempts"."max_score" IS NOT NULL AND "attempts"."score" <= "attempts"."max_score")

generation_runs_type_integrity_check.name: generation_runs_type_integrity_check
generation_runs_type_integrity_check.value: ("generation_runs"."type" = 'module' AND "generation_runs"."generation_request_id" IS NOT NULL AND "generation_runs"."adaptive_intervention_id" IS NULL) OR ("generation_runs"."type" = 'adaptive' AND "generation_runs"."generation_request_id" IS NULL AND "generation_runs"."adaptive_intervention_id" IS NOT NULL)

module_nodes_origin_integrity_check.name: module_nodes_origin_integrity_check
module_nodes_origin_integrity_check.value: ("module_nodes"."origin" = 'core' AND "module_nodes"."core_position" IS NOT NULL AND "module_nodes"."adaptive_intervention_id" IS NULL AND "module_nodes"."adaptive_position" IS NULL) OR ("module_nodes"."origin" = 'adaptive' AND "module_nodes"."core_position" IS NULL AND "module_nodes"."adaptive_intervention_id" IS NOT NULL AND "module_nodes"."adaptive_position" IS NOT NULL)

modules_ready_title_check.name: modules_ready_title_check
modules_ready_title_check.value: "modules"."status" NOT IN ('ready', 'archived') OR "modules"."title" IS NOT NULL
